target_customer: Enterprise finance and accounts receivable teams with many customers and high invoice volume
problem: Order to cash work such as collections, portals, disputes and remittances is too messy for rule based automation, so it is outsourced or done manually and payment is delayed.
business_model: Managed AI service where agents plus finance experts run order to cash to SLA
product_category: AI operations service for accounts receivable and order to cash

founders.name: Lewis Blackwood
previous_startups: Personably (co-founder, backed by Global Founders Capital)

competitors.name: Fazeshift
competitors.what: AI agents for accounts receivable, invoices and collections
competitors.traction_then: Company reports 12x revenue growth in one year, unverified

competitors.name: Monk
competitors.what: AI native accounts receivable platform for invoicing, collections and cash application

competitors.name: Paraglide AI
competitors.what: AI agents for accounts receivable and collections

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must work inside ERPs, email and customer portals with many exceptions, and a managed service adds human review, but the building blocks are available.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into a customer's AR operations and accumulated customer context make it sticky, while the model layer is shared with competitors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded AR automation startups raised Series A rounds in spring 2026 on the same wedge. No acquisition of Rex found.

market_need_then: The company says order to cash is a 60B USD outsourced function. It reports managing over 500M USD in receivables and a 12 day DSO improvement at a customer, both company reported and unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct, as in Agents now run order to cash

branding.community_and_virality: Won first place at the Vercel AI Accelerator demo day in April 2026 and launched on Product Hunt.

brand_strength.rationale: A short name but shared with several unrelated companies named Rex, and no brand coverage was found beyond accelerator and launch posts.

outcome_analysis: Rex is an active Summer 2026 company. Founders spent four years at Sequence, an order to cash platform, which gives them domain insight. It won the Vercel AI Accelerator and has a named customer in Synthesia, though funding amounts are undisclosed. Well funded AR startups compete, so execution decides the outcome.
notes: Vercel Ventures invested after the April 2026 accelerator win per the Vercel recap, amount not disclosed, so no round is recorded with an amount. One directory lists London as the base while YC lists San Francisco. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Brand search found no name origin.
